text:
marco: quick Q — I'm landing a Terraform change to provision a multi‑AZ GPU node pool for inference. goal is: reserved capacity in two AZs for steady throughput, with spot fallback across the cluster. planning to use g5/GA-type instances. any red flags?

priya: sounds fine. couple things to confirm:
- which instance types exactly (g5.xlarge vs g5.2xlarge) — mixing sizes impacts packing/price
- do we want capacityReservation for the reserved subpool or use dedicated host reservations?
- what's the autoscaler strategy for the mixed spot/reserved groups?

marco: thanks — thinking instance_types = ["g5.2xlarge"] for reserved (predictable perf), and a separate ASG for spot using g5.xlarge + g4dn.xlarge as cheaper fallbacks. capacity reservation will be used on the reserved ASG via Terraform arg. snippet I plan to add: 
```hcl
module "gpu_reserved_pool" {
  source = "./modules/node_pool"
  name   = "gpu-reserved-azab"
  instance_types = ["g5.2xlarge"]
  capacity_reservation = true
  availability_zones = ["us-east-1a","us-east-1b"]
  taints = { "dedicated_gpu" = "true:NoSchedule" }
}

module "gpu_spot_pool" {
  source = "./modules/node_pool"
  name   = "gpu-spot-global"
  instance_types = ["g5.xlarge","g4dn.xlarge"]
  spot = true
  max_unavailable = 1
}
```

sasha: minor config notes:
- add node labels for model-class (e.g., "gpu.class=highmem") so k8s schedules properly.
- ensure the node taint above has tolerations in the inference deployment.
- for mixed instance groups, cluster-autoscaler needs explicit node-group tags and "--expander=most-pods" tuned.

benji: also watch kubelet eviction thresholds. spot nodes will drain and pods may be rescheduled to reserved nodes only if tolerations/affinity permit. I'd add a pod disruption budget for the inference Stateful/Deployment and set topologySpreadConstraints to prefer AZ balance.

marco: good point re: tolerations. example toleration in the deployment: 
```yaml
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      tolerations:
      - key: "dedicated_gpu"
        operator: "Equal"
        value: "true"
        effect: "NoSchedule"
      nodeSelector:
        gpu.class: "highmem"
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity: {} # prefer spread across AZs
```

priya: secret/wiring question — model artifacts are in S3 encrypted with a customer KMS key. nodes need IAM role to Decrypt and the bootstrap script needs aws kms decrypt for env files. We should:
- attach an instance profile to reserved ASG with kms:Decrypt + s3:GetObject on model bucket
- store bootstrap creds in aws-ssm parameter (encrypted) or use IRSA for the service account if we want pod-level access

marco: plan is instance profile on nodes for now (simpler). we'll follow up if we do IRSA later.

infra-bot: PR #742 created by marco: "multi-az gpu reserved + spot fallback" — run CI and plan. :white_check_mark:

benji: one more — terraform plan will show VPC ENI limits per AZ. GPU instances can consume more ENIs; make sure we set ENI headroom or use ENI-aware packing to avoid schedule failures. Also consider node labels for accelerator-type to move future model rollouts without re-provisioning.

ops-lead: looks reasonable. action items: 
- marco: include the tolerations and node labels in the module defaults (so teams don't forget)
- priya: confirm IAM policy + KMS key arn to attach to the instance profile
- benji: add autoscaler config (node-group tags + expander) to the terraform module
- sasha: quick smoke test once reserved pool is up (canary across two AZs)

marco: will push a follow-up commit with labels/tolerations and link the smoke test plan. will also run a dry terraform apply in staging later today. thanks! :rocket:
